t: You're on Brunel Road, a street in the London Borough of Southwark. It is named after Marc Isambard Brunel, who lived from 1769 to 1849. He was a French-born engineer who did his most famous work in Britain. He built the Thames Tunnel, the world's first underwater tunnel. He was also the father of Isambard Kingdom Brunel. The name here recalls that tunnelling achievement and a family of engineers.
